closest_prior_work.relation: Prior results establish a broad H3+H7 final-label path but no selective cross-format factor interchange. V1 was abandoned before implementation because it ambiguously selected both factor type and head subset.

novelty: First matched list-versus-digit-sequence test of exact L8H3+H7 score and cached-value transfer with identical visible labels and next-label answers. V2 fixes the known H3+H7 pair and has no learned or outcome-selected subset. FIT and SELECT evaluate the identical preordered arms.

registered_screens.shared_payload_private_router: cross-format cached-value transfer is at least 70 percent of within-format cached-value transfer in every behavior-by-direction cell with at least 75 percent donor-direction rows and positive CE support; cross score may fail
registered_screens.shared_score_and_payload: cross-format joint transfer is at least 70 percent of within-format joint transfer and cross-format score transfer is at least 50 percent in every behavior-by-direction cell
registered_screens.generic_numeral_or_copy_bus: target transfer holds but repeated-list-copy, digit-copy, or step-two active control fails
registered_screens.location_only_null: the fixed H3+H7 target transfer itself fails

required_controls: freeze matched FIT and SELECT authorities with identical visible three-number states and next-label answers across list and digit-sequence formats
evaluate exactly native replay, within-format score/cached/joint, cross-format score/cached/joint, and same-state cross-format joint; no factor or head selection
score replacement changes only p_h; cached replacement changes only the lambda8 v0 contribution while retaining recipient v8; joint changes both for h3 and h7
native recipient/donor capability at least 85 percent in every target and control cell
exact replay, source sum, and cached-value decomposition relative squared errors at most 1e-10; installed term error at most 1e-5
within-format joint effect recovers at least 50 percent of natural margin effect with at least 75 percent donor-direction rows
repeated-list copy, digit copy, and step-two controls receive the identical nonzero cross-format score/cached/joint interventions; intervention norm at least 10 percent of target scale
controls preserve at least 75 percent answers or registered preferences, absolute mean CE change at most 0.10 nat, and median absolute margin change at most 25 percent of target scale
task margin and CE determine verdicts; full-vocabulary RMS is descriptive only
FIT and SELECT are reported separately with identical fixed arms and bars
interpretation_limits: A pass establishes operational reuse for matched list and digit-sequence formats, not an abstract numeral concept.
V2 does not identify a single head or earlier numeral source; those are conditional successors only after fixed-pair transfer and controls hold.
Fresh values/templates and word-number transfer remain separate confirmation questions.
